description: Establish standardized PEP 440 cumulative build counters (+build.r1) in module headers across all digital archive Python scripts.
payload: * **Header Metadata Lines (Lines 1–3):** Every Python source file must open with comments declaring `# Name: [filename]`, `# Path: [relative_path]`, and `# Version: 1.0.0+build.r[counter]`, followed by `__version__ = "1.0.0+build.r[counter]"`.
